description: Validates Kubernetes workload manifests for resource safety, image pinning, probe definitions, and rollout correctness

rules.description: k8s-workload-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare name, kind, image, and replicas
Every label in selectorLabels must also appear in podLabels. Kubernetes rejects workloads where the selector does not match the pod template
Every container must declare CPU and memory requests (for the scheduler) and a memory limit (to prevent OOM eviction of other pods). CPU limits are optional but requests are mandatory
Every container image must be pinned to an explicit version tag or SHA digest. Mutable tags cause non-deterministic deployments
All ConfigMaps and Secrets referenced via envFrom or volumeMounts must be explicitly listed in spec.declaredRefs. Undeclared refs cause CrashLoopBackOff with cryptic errors at scheduling time
strategy.type must be RollingUpdate or Recreate. RollingUpdate parameters maxSurge and maxUnavailable must be non-negative integers or percentage strings (e.g. '25%'). DaemonSet is skipped
rules.note: Skipped for DaemonSet; passes when no strategy is declared (Kubernetes default applies)

rules.description: k8s-workload-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

livenessProbe and readinessProbe must be defined. Namespace must be declared (default namespace is an antipattern in shared clusters). Single-replica Deployments without HPA cause downtime during rolling updates
rules.note: Probe check can be skipped with skipProbeCheck: true; single-replica check with skipSingleReplicaCheck: true
